newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is expected to leave key rates unchanged tomorrow at the start of a new commercial bank reserve period, due to disappointing May inflation data, according to nine out of 10 analysts of banks and brokers polled by Reuters.

Although the May inflation figure was not expected to jeopardise the government's 1997 inflation target, the analysts said they expected the Bank of Portugal to wait for June prices data before cutting rates further.
The Bank of Portugal sets new money market conditions at 1315 GMT tomorrow.
Presently the repo rate stands at 6.00 percent, the draining rate at 5.7 percent and the emergency lending rate at 7.70 percent.
The poll results are as follows:
1. Could the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate this week?
No - 9
Yes - 1
2. If the answer to question 1. is yes, by how much?
20 basis points
3. Could the Bank of Portugal cut the draining rate this week?
No - 9
Yes - 1
4. If the answer to question 3. is yes, by how much?
20 basis points
5. Is there room for more rate cuts by the Bank of Portugal?
No - 0
Yes - 10

NOTE: Participants in the poll who agreed to be identified are the following: Banco Portugues de Investimento; IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Fincor; Credit Lyonnais; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; and Banco Essi.
